method.angle: atan(dy/dx) in image degrees, positive downward to right; not robot theta
method.edge: Gaussian sigma=1 px; signed vertical gradient for initialization; continuous Gaussian-blurred step B+A*CDF((y-center)/sigma) fitted to 11 samples per column, 30 active-bound Gauss-Newton iterations
method.fit: cv2.fitLine DIST_HUBER, param=0 (OpenCV default Huber scale); centered point coordinates; reps=1e-6, aeps=1e-8
method.diagnostics: Initial quadratic-peak result, L2 fit, central-80%-segment Huber angle, and Gaussian sigma=2 px angle also saved; no accuracy acceptance threshold implied by solver settings
method.location: Previously saved affine displacement at patch center used only for translating search ROI; no affine resampling
method.scope: Per-line descriptive response and label-based feasibility; no hardware control or mechanical cause attribution
method.selection: 12 lines fixed from center.bmp and mentor-marked structural regions before label-response evaluation
